pull.title: KAFKA-21364: Keep the offset reset of a revived task closed before initialization
pull.body:
Under exactly-once, a corrupted task (for example after a commit times
out) is closed dirty, which drops the records it fetched but has not
processed yet. It is then revived with its input partitions marked to be
reset to the committed offsets. That reset only runs once the revived
task is initialized and completes restoration.

With the classic protocol, StreamThread enforces a rebalance right after
the corruption, and any assignment that arrives before the revived task
is initialized has the same effect: handleTasksPendingInitialization
closes the revived task and a new task is created for the same task id.
The new task starts with no pending reset, so it processes from the
current consumer position, and the next commit moves the input offset
past the dropped records. Those records never reach the state store or
the changelog.

This change keeps the input partitions that a task closed while pending
initialization still had to reset, and hands them to the new active task
created in the same assignment, limited to that task's input partitions
that are still assigned to the consumer. ReadOnlyTask throws on the new
Task#partitionsForOffsetReset, like the other mutating and non-read-only
methods.

CommitTimeoutOffsetResetIntegrationTest reproduces the loss by delaying
the EndTxn response past max.block.ms, and new unit tests in
TaskManagerTest and StreamTaskTest cover the hand-over.

reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are recorded for the change preserving pending offset resets across task replacement. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR prevents Kafka Streams from skipping buffered input records under exactly-once processing when a revived task is replaced before initialization. Pending offset resets are preserved and transferred to replacement active tasks for input partitions still assigned to the consumer. **Changes:** - Preserve pending offset resets across task replacement during assignment. - Add a task accessor for pending resets, with read-only task access explicitly rejected. - Add unit coverage and an integration regression test using a delayed transaction-commit response. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `streams/​src/​test/​java/​org/​apache/​kafka/​streams/​processor/​internals/​TaskManagerTest.java` | Tests reset handover from a revived task to its replacement. | | `streams/​src/​test/​java/​org/​apache/​kafka/​streams/​processor/​internals/​StreamTaskTest.java` | Tests pending-reset visibility before and after restoration. | | `streams/​src/​main/​java/​org/​apache/​kafka/​streams/​processor/​internals/​TaskManager.java` | Saves pending resets before closure and transfers them to replacement active tasks. | | `streams/​src/​main/​java/​org/​apache/​kafka/​streams/​processor/​internals/​Task.java` | Adds a default accessor for pending offset resets. | | `streams/​src/​main/​java/​org/​apache/​kafka/​streams/​processor/​internals/​StreamTask.java` | Returns an immutable snapshot of pending resets. | | `streams/​src/​main/​java/​org/​apache/​kafka/​streams/​processor/​internals/​ReadOnlyTask.java` | Rejects access through the new accessor. | | `streams/​integration-tests/​src/​test/​java/​org/​apache/​kafka/​streams/​integration/​CommitTimeoutOffsetResetIntegrationTest.java` | Verifies that commit-timeout recovery preserves all input keys in the state store. |
Review effort: Balanced
